Nutrition Tips
	1.	 Read labels to find foods low in fat and cholesterol. Try for 
3 grams of fat or less per serving.
	2.	 Read labels to find “hidden” carbohydrate. For example, 
hot dogs actually contain a lot of carbohydrate. Most hot 
dogs are also high in fat, but are often sold in lower-fat 
versions.
